# Third-party dependencies

| Component | Source | Notices |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sherpa-onnx | [Source and library details](sherpa-onnx/README.md) | `sherpa-onnx/LICENSE`, `sherpa-onnx/licenses/` |
| ONNX Runtime 1.28.0 | [Microsoft release](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/releases/tag/v1.28.0) | Included in each archive |
| Silero VAD | [Silero](https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad) | `models/silero-vad/LICENSE` |
| 3D-Speaker ERes2NetV2 | [3D-Speaker](https://github.com/modelscope/3D-Speaker) | `models/3D-Speaker-ERes2NetV2/LICENSE` |
| Inno Setup 7.1.1 | [Inno Setup](https://jrsoftware.org/isdl.php) | `license.txt` in the archive |
| llama.cpp | [llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp) | `llama.cpp/LICENSE` and runtime notices |

The Linux ONNX Runtime archive is unchanged. The Windows archive contains
`lib/onnxruntime.dll`, `LICENSE` and `ThirdPartyNotices.txt` from the official
`onnxruntime-win-x64-gpu_cuda13-1.28.0.zip`, with their contents unchanged.
The Inno Setup archive contains the compiler distribution and its license.
